authorities: Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission (FWC)
Florida Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services (FDACS)
NOAA Fisheries / regional federal fishery managers where represented
NOAA Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary
notes: FWC is the controlling Florida authority; Fish Rules is used as a secondary species-coverage and UX cross-check.
The regulatory/search catalog contains saltwater fish, marine life and protected resources plus Florida freshwater game fish, nongame fish, amphibians, crayfish, mussels/clams and freshwater turtles.
The camera classifier remains 75 trained classes. Regulatory/search-only profiles never claim camera identification support.
fishinfo.json, fishinfo.v2.json and fishinfo.v3.json are generated as one matching catalog release and are versioned/downloaded together.
The model bundle (labels/report/ONNX) is independent so regulation-only updates do not force a model download.
The packaged Resources/Raw payload is the offline fallback. The updater will not let older cached or remote files shadow/downgrade a newer packaged baseline.
Freshwater map context applies statewide freshwater rules but cannot distinguish dry land from water or identify every named waterbody/FMA; the UI warns the user to confirm exact waterbody rules.
Oyster and hard-clam profiles require exact-location FDACS harvesting-area classification and current daily OPEN/CLOSED verification.
images.json now carries a SHA-256 for every downloadable card; updater image staging verifies manifest/count/hash and replaces changed files atomically on image releases.
